contracts.fallback: dsh-host-webserver 0.1.x ctx.webServer (exact/prefix HTTP routes + exact upgrade routes)
missing credentials service disables cookie storage; manual-cookie mode only

permissions.name: dsh.overleaf.network-proxy
permissions.scope: outbound https to config.baseUrl origin + the user-content output origin the site itself announces (meta ol-compilesUserContentDomain / compile pdfDownloadDomain); credential-free GET of https://static.texpage.com/dist/console.<hash>.js; HTTP/WebSocket for /socket.io/ and HTTP /heartbeat on the upstream-announced exact socket.<configured hostname minus www> host, using the original page Origin and the configured site's session cookies; isolated credential-free GET/HEAD of announced latex-file.texpageusercontent.com compile PDF/log paths; bounded bibliography and TeX source readback via the configured site's authenticated /api/project/file followed by at most one credential-free GET to that fixed file host with exact owner/file/version identity
permissions.reason: The workbench forwards browser traffic to the configured self-hosted or public Overleaf instance and fetches compiled output files (PDF/logs) from the origin that instance designates.

permissions.name: dsh.overleaf.credential-store
permissions.reason: Store the captured Overleaf session cookie so reboots do not require re-login.

permissions.name: dsh.overleaf.workspace-bibliography-read
permissions.scope: regular .bib files contained by the active DSH session workspace; recursive discovery depth 8, at most 50 candidates, at most 2 MiB per selected file
permissions.reason: Let the user explicitly synchronize a local workspace bibliography into the matching bibliography document in the embedded Overleaf project.

permissions.name: dsh.overleaf.workspace-tex-read
permissions.scope: regular .tex files contained by the active DSH session workspace; recursive discovery depth 8, at most 100 candidates, at most 4 MiB per selected file
permissions.reason: Let the user explicitly synchronize one local workspace LaTeX source into the currently open, identity-verified Overleaf .tex document.

permissions.name: dsh.overleaf.workspace-tex-write
permissions.scope: create or replace one regular .tex file inside the active DSH session workspace after an explicit Overleaf-to-local sync action; no directory creation; 4 MiB limit; write rollback and readback verification
permissions.reason: Let the user save the complete currently open Overleaf .tex source into a chosen local workspace file, or create a same-named file at the workspace root when no local .tex exists.

permissions.name: dsh.overleaf.current-tex-edit
permissions.scope: the single currently open Overleaf .tex source document only, after an explicit reverse-direction confirmation; document-id/revision check, pre-change snapshot, readback verification, and save confirmation required
permissions.reason: Support user-confirmed local-to-Overleaf whole-document synchronization without silently overwriting a switched or concurrently edited document.
